final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.transref AS transaction_id, t.tradekind AS trader_type, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref COLLATE BINARY = r.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref COLLATE BINARY = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_reports) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.trader_type, step1.avg_analyst_reports, step1.avg_analyst_reports - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE step1.avg_analyst_reports > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT trader_type, AVG(avg_analyst_reports) AS type_avg, AVG(difference) AS avg_difference FROM step3 GROUP BY trader_type), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS overall_type_avg FROM step4) SELECT step4.trader_type, step4.type_avg, step4.avg_difference, step4.type_avg / step5.overall_type_avg FROM step4 JOIN step5 ON step5.overall_type_avg IS NOT NULL
